# 1997/no-es2-features

📝 Disallow JavaScript features introduced after ECMAScript 1 (1997).

💼 This rule is enabled in the ✅ `recommended` config.

<!-- end auto-generated rule header -->

Disallows syntax features introduced in ECMAScript 2 (1998) or later.

This includes arrow functions, classes, `let`/`const`, template literals,
destructuring, spread/rest, default parameters, generators, async/await,
`for-of`, optional chaining, nullish coalescing, and more.
